notes.title: Rebranding to Asterook!
notes.content: Initially the name "Groid" was supposed to mean "Gr"appling hook and aster"oid", however as we later found out that also is a racial slur for negroid. Therefor we sat down and decided that we should rename it since it is an actual thing and not just an entry in urban dictionary. We want to apologize if anyone felt offended by that. It was not supposed to mean anything harmful.
